title: Grand Canyon Scenic Airlines
specs: World's oldest air tour operator, flying since 1927
FAA Part 135 Certified with meticulous maintenance and experienced pilots
Every seat is a window seat with oversized windows and high-wing aircraft
Tours include views of Hoover Dam, Lake Mead, Colorado River, and multiple Grand Canyon viewpoints
Passengers 18+ must present valid REAL ID-compliant driver’s license or passport for US flights
No photocopies or digital images of ID accepted
Fleet can accommodate groups of any size; custom sightseeing events available for large groups

blurb: Guests take scenic airplane tours from Las Vegas, Boulder City, South Rim, and Page to view the Grand Canyon and other landmarks from the air. Some tours include ground transportation, helicopter rides, boat cruises, and visits to lookout points and cultural sites. Tours range from short flights to full-day excursions with multiple activities.
